Initial release of Image to Video ImageMover

- Convert still images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC up to 200MB) into 1080p MP4 video clips in 30–90 seconds.
- Automatic session, token, and API setup with free trial support (100 credits, 7-day expiry).
- Upload image files, generate videos with transitions, background music, and text overlays—ideal for social media creators.
- Full cloud rendering pipeline with download links and session persistence for editing workflows.
- Handles errors (token/session, file size/type, credits, usage limits) with clear user messages and actionable suggestions.
